title: Unit – 1 : Session – 9 : SLO – 2 | Lambda and Stream API
sections: 1) Filter + print: List<Integer> nums = List.of(1,2,3,4,5,6);  nums.stream().filter(n -> n % 2 == 0).forEach(System.out::println); — prints 2, 4, 6.
2) Lambda comparing two integers: (a, b) -> Integer.compare(a, b)  used as Comparator<Integer> cmp = (a, b) -> a - b;  or BiFunction<Integer,Integer,Integer> max = (a,b) -> a > b ? a : b;

3) Chained map/filter/collect: List<String> r = List.of("apple","bat","cherry","dog").stream().filter(s -> s.length() > 3).map(String::toUpperCase).collect(Collectors.toList()); — result: [APPLE, CHERRY].
